assembly.name: Electrical — ECU, gateway, battery & harness
assembly.description: The car's nervous system (dossier §7): Bosch MED 17.5.2 engine ECU (verify against SIMOS 18 on the actual car's label), the J533 gateway bridging powertrain CAN-C / comfort CAN-B / infotainment / LIN / diagnostic CAN, EFB/AGM battery with recuperation, fuse box, and the main harness runs. Lighting units live in the body shell parts.

parts.name: Engine ECU — SIMOS 18.1 (J623)
parts.description: R10 RESOLUTION of the dossier's open ECU question: the CJXC Golf R runs a Continental (Siemens VDO) SIMOS 18.1, part family 5G0906259 (e.g. -B/-F, software SC800H5100000 / SC800O3000000) — NOT Bosch MED 17.5.x. Beware the sibling trap: the S3 8V uses 8V0906259. Treat as settled pending a VCDS scan of this VIN.

parts.name: Gateway J533 (CAN bridge)
parts.description: CAN gateway J533 (5Q0907530 family) — the hub between Powertrain CAN (500 kbit/s), Convenience, Infotainment and Diagnostic CAN. R10: the topology is pure CAN + LIN, NO FlexRay; the OBD port exposes only the Diagnostic CAN (ISO 15765-4, 500 kbaud, 11-bit). The central gateway bridging CAN-C powertrain (engine, DSG, ABS/ESC, Haldex), CAN-B comfort, infotainment CAN/MOST, LIN sub-buses and the diagnostic CAN to the OBD port (dossier §7). Phase 8 idea from the dossier: overlay the bus topology on the model.

parts.name: Battery (EFB/AGM, ~68–72 Ah) & tray
parts.description: AGM 68 Ah / 380 A (DIN) H6 battery, family 000915105 (e.g. 000915105FC; the 420 CCA figure on US listings is the SAE rating of the same battery) (R10). No BMW-style registration, but a battery or J367 monitor swap requires the 19-Gateway adaptation per VW TSB 2053976 / 27-19-01.

parts.name: Fuse / relay box
parts.description: Main engine-bay fuse and relay carrier beside the battery.

parts.name: Main wiring harness runs
parts.description: The trunk runs: bay → bulkhead → floor → rear, plus the cross-bay branch (dossier §7 lists engine-bay, cabin, door and rear zone harnesses).

parts.name: ACC radar unit (Bosch, front)
parts.description: Front distance-control radar behind the bumper/badge area. R10: the pre-facelift R uses the BOSCH unit, controller family 5Q0907572 (J/P suffixes — exact one unconfirmed for this car; HW 3QF907572), housing 5Q0907541. The Continental 5Q0907561 is facelift-only — wrong part. After any bumper/radar disturbance it needs calibration: coding 14117 in address 13, 120 cm target, 0.00° ±0.80°. NOTE for this car's live fault: 'ACC not available' is a CATCH-ALL that also mirrors drivetrain faults (e.g. cam-adjuster codes) — scan address 13 AND 01 before condemning the radar.
knownIssues: Misalignment after light front impacts → ACC unavailable until recalibrated (R10).
'ACC not available' with no radar fault often traces to engine-side DTCs — check both controllers (R10).
